What is YouLearnt?
An online learning platform that connects learners worldwide with the right tutors and mentors, breaking down geographical and other barriers to quality education.



YouLearnt Vision:
The world’s leading platform for personalised education, where every learner, regardless of background or location, discovers exactly what they seek and fulfils their passion for knowledge.



YouLearnt Mission:
We bring people together from all corners of the globe to achieve their educational goals, creating a dynamic community of learners and educators. By removing geographical barriers, our platform ensures that high-quality education is accessible to all, no matter the circumstances.



What problems YouLearnt solve:

Removing Barriers to Learning

Many individuals face challenges in accessing personalised and specialised learning opportunities due to geographical constraints, limited availability of instructors, and lack of platforms connecting learners with educators globally.

Solving the E-Learning Gap

Many schools, universities, institutions, training centres, and course providers need to switch to online or hybrid learning but lack the time and resources to build a complete e-learning system.



YouLearnt solutions

YouLearnt is a comprehensive digital learning platform that addresses these challenges by offering a seamless, engaging, and effective educational experience.


Evaluation & Homework Management

Educators can easily track student progress and provide detailed feedback, saving time and improving learning outcomes.

Global Accessibility

Breaking geographical barriers, we connect learners with top educators and ensure education is accessible from anywhere in the world.

Seamless Hybrid Learning Integration

Universities and institutions can transition smoothly to online or hybrid models without requiring additional infrastructure.

Social Learning & Collaboration Tools

Built-in messaging, discussion boards, and notifications foster engagement between students and instructors.

Attendance Tracking & Lecture Recording

Automated attendance monitoring and on-demand access to recorded lectures ensure students never miss a lesson.

24/7 Technical Support

We provide round-the-clock assistance to ensure a seamless learning experience for students and educators.



How YouLearnt deal with Individual (B2C)

Free profile creation for tutors.

Commission-based revenue model incentivises quality instruction.

Tiered commission structure rewards educator dedication.

Competitive commission rates attract and retain top talent.





How YouLearnt deal with Organisations (B2B)

Free course trial to learn about the platform and its capabilities.

A percentage of the course income ranges from 20 to 30%.





What kind of classes on YouLearnt?

We offer three types of classes:

One-to-One:

First Lesson

Package Lesson

Group:

Group Course






YouLearnt commission

Tutors can create their profiles on YouLearnt for free. The commission is charged when a tutor begins lessons with students.

 For every first lesson with a new student, YouLearnt charges a commission of 75%. This helps fund our efforts in creating ads and promotions to attract new students. To receive 25% from the first lesson, it depends on the student booking a package with you. If the student does not book a package, you will not receive compensation for the trial session, as we anticipate that the student may not be satisfied and could request a refund.

For all the following, the commission rate is 25%. It will decrease when you spend hours teaching on YouLearnt. After 300 hours of teaching, the commission will go down to 20%, and then after 1000 hours, it will be only 15%. 

 

When the Tutor spends 300 hours teaching on YouLearnt, they will be promoted to Senior Tutor and can change their profile URL to be easy to spread. The Senior Tutor becomes a Professional Tutor after spending 1000 hours teaching on YouLearnt.



Creating an Account:


Visit YouLearnt: Open your web browser and go to YouLearnt

Sign Up: Register as a student or as a tutor by clicking on “Register as a Student” or “Register as a Tutor” buttons.

Enter Your Details: Fill in the required information, including your name, email address, and a secure password.

Add Subject: Choose the subject that you will teach from the dropdown menu if registering as a Tutor.

Agree to Terms: Read and accept the Terms and Conditions, Privacy Policy, and Cookies Policy.

Submit: Click the "Student Registration" or "Tutor Registration" button, depending on the type of account you are creating, to complete the registration process.

Verification: Check your email for a verification link and click on it to verify your account.



Logging In:


Visit the Website: Go to YouLearnt.

Log In: Click on the "Log In" button at the top right corner of the page.

Enter Credentials: Provide your registered email address and password.

Submit: Click the "Log In" button to access your account.



Navigating the Platform:

Navigating the Platform:


Become a Tutor:



Tutor Homepage:

The tutor's homepage provides an overview of the platform and its features. The homepage opens to the dashboard where you can check:



The total number of students registered with you.

The total hours you have taught.

The total payments fulfilled by the students.

Upcoming scheduled lessons.

Notifications.


Tutor's Dashboard:

In the Dashboard, you can find comprehensive navigation options for your profile, covering all necessary details and information pertinent to your role as a tutor.




When you click on "View my Profile" you will access your public profile on YouLearnt. In your public profile, YouLearnt users can view your picture, bio, subjects taught, number of students, rating, and languages you speak. Additionally, they can access information such as:



About: Includes details about the tutor, education, certifications, and work experience.

Pictures: Images shared by the tutor related to the subjects taught.

Videos: Videos shared by the tutor related to the subjects taught.

Timetable: Available slots in the tutor's schedule that students can book.

Reviews: Reviews given by students.

Blog posts: Blog posts shared by the tutor on YouLearnt's blog.

Community: Questions added by the tutor in YouLearnt's community.



The tutor can check the following on the statistics page:



Profile Views: Number of profile views.

Profile Position: Ratings given to the tutor by the students.

Profile Score: Consists of several criteria, determining the tutor's position in the search results.

Hourly Rate: The hourly rate for each subject taught by the tutor.

Total Students: The total number of students.

Availability: Number of hours available for the tutor to teach.

Cancelled Lessons: Lessons canceled by the tutor.

Absences: Lessons that the tutor did not attend.

Active Students: Students who currently have lessons with the tutor.



Tutors can share articles on the "Blog" to share knowledge and express personal viewpoints. Posts can be added by clicking on the red "Add a new post" button on the upper-right side.

After a tutor publishes an article in the blog, it undergoes a review by the platform to ensure compliance with YouLearnt’s terms and policies. Once approved, the article becomes live and can be viewed and interacted with by platform users.

It's important to note that publishing in the Blog contributes to a tutor's points in their profile score.





To publish a new question in the YouLearnt community, you need to add the following information:



Required:



Question

Subject

Category

Language

Optional:



Tags

Additional details

After a tutor posts a question in the community, it needs to undergo a review by the platform to ensure it complies with the YouLearnt’s terms and policies. Once approved, the question becomes live and can be viewed and interacted with by platform users.

It's important to note that a tutor's interaction with the community contributes to their points in the profile score.






From the ''Classrooms'' page, tutors can see all the classes they teach, whether they are one-to-one sessions or group courses. The course summary appears on this page, including financial information, class hour details, and the class language (if the tutor teaches in more than one language).



When tutors click on the "View the course" button under each course, they can see more details and manage the course, such as scheduling and rescheduling classes, chatting with students, and viewing booked lessons.



On the "Add a new course" page, tutors can set the course details such as the course name, subject, course fees, maximum number of students, description (more specific details about the course), and an image. After setting the course times, the tutor can click "Submit".



Once the necessary information is entered, the group course will be available for students to see and book.





We have a feature on the platform that enables students to publish a post requesting a tutor with specific details to suit their needs. Tutors can then send offers to the student, detailing how they are able to teach what the student wants. The student can choose from these offers.



From the "Find Students" page, tutors can look for potential students to teach by offering a competitive price and writing a compelling brief about themselves in the "offer details" section.



From the "My Proposals" page, tutors can view the offers they have sent to students and see whether their offers have been approved or not.

Once the necessary information is entered, the group course will be available for students to see and book.

The "Invite Friends" page allows tutors to share the YouLearnt platform with their friends and colleagues. Tutors can send direct invitations to their friends via email. They just need to choose the language, enter their friend's name and email, and they can invite any number of friends at one time by clicking on "Invite one more friend".



We have a ''Referrals'' program on YouLearnt where each user gets a unique link to share. If this link attracts new users to the platform, the referrer will earn a percentage of the value of the first class the new student books, or the first package the new tutor teaches, depending on the referrer's role. The earned credit can be used for learning within the platform.






Account Settings:

Tutors can add and edit all their information through the "Account Settings" The Account Settings include the following:

Profile Settings

Finances

Become a Student



Profile Settings:



On the "Profile Settings" page, the tutor will find many options to manage their profile and enhance their teaching experience on YouLearnt:



Personal information

A certified tutor always gets more traffic on their profile than others. On the "Background" page, the tutor can provide details about their "Teaching certification," "Education," and "Work experience".





The tutor selects one subject that they teach during the registration process. However, the tutor needs to add specific details regarding the subject they will teach through the "Subjects" page.



To edit and add the subject's details, the tutor can click on the blue editing icon. Here, they can specify the number of hours required for a student to earn a certificate (optional), and upload photos and videos related to the teaching subject (also optional). However, setting the hourly rate is required.







In YouLearnt, tutors can teach more than one subject. They can click on "+ Add another subject" to add additional subjects and then proceed to add details similar to the first subject.



Just as the tutor can add a subject, they can also delete a subject they no longer wish to teach by clicking on the red icon.

If a tutor wishes to teach a specific subject not currently listed on YouLearnt, they can request to add the subject by clicking on the plus sign next to "Select a subject". This request will be forwarded to the platform management for consideration. If YouLearnt approves the addition of the subject, it will become available for all tutors to teach, and students can search for tutors offering lessons in this subject.





On the "Profile Description" page, tutors can provide information about themselves to help students make informed decisions:



Bio: Provide a brief biography outlining your professional background, teaching experience, and any relevant achievements.



Introduction about themselves (in English): Write a concise introduction about yourself in English. Include your teaching philosophy, areas of expertise, and what students can expect from your classes.



Introduction about themselves in other languages they speak: If you speak multiple languages, introduce yourself briefly in those languages. This helps students who prefer to communicate in languages other than English.



Make an introduction video and upload it to your profile: Create a video introducing yourself. In the video, you can discuss your teaching style, passion for education, and why students should choose you as their tutor.







From the "Availability" page, tutors can manage their lesson schedule effectively. They can add, edit, and delete available dates and times that appear in the timetable section of their profile. This allows students to view and book lessons directly based on the tutor's availability.









Tutors have the ability to block users, and they can view the list of blocked users on the "Block List" page. If necessary, tutors can also unblock users from this page.

Students trust verified tutors when booking lessons. Tutors can upload a copy of their ID through the "Verify Identity" option in the "Account Settings" menu. Verified tutors receive a verification mark on their profile and can withdraw from their wallet easily.





Everything related to finances is available on the "Finances" page. Tutors can view their financial transactions and check the dashboard to see total earnings for the month, along with detailed transaction history. Additionally, tutors can add a withdrawal method to access their earnings.



Become A Student/ Become A Tutor:



We believe in lifelong learning, as a person learns until the last day of their life. With the click of a button, a tutor can switch to a student profile by clicking "Become a Student", allowing them to search for tutors in fields or skills they wish to learn. After completing their role as a student, they can click "Become a Tutor" to return to their tutor profile and continue teaching their students.

Recommendations:

YouLearnt recommends tutors to students based on the information entered through the "Recommendation" section. This includes the "subjects" the student wants to learn, the "native language" in which the student prefers to be taught, the "native country of the tutor" they want to learn from, and the "time zone" in which the student resides.









We have an ''Affiliate Marketing'' program through which influencers on various social media networks can register. 

By publishing their unique link, they can earn a commission for every new user who joins YouLearnt. Registration for affiliate marketing is separate from the rest of the platform system, whether as a student or a tutor. 

It requires a different email address, as the same email cannot be used for both a student or tutor account and an affiliate account.





The YouLearnt Blog page is a dynamic resource where you can find a wealth of articles, insights, and updates on various educational topics. Authored by experts and educators, the blog covers a wide range of subjects including study tips, course highlights, industry trends, and personal development strategies. Whether you are looking to enhance your learning experience, stay informed about the latest in education, or gain inspiration from success stories, the YouLearnt Blog provides valuable content to support your educational journey.



Additionally, the platform allows tutors to publish their own articles in their fields. These articles are reviewed by platform experts to ensure they comply with YouLearnt’s publishing standards before being approved for publication.







The YouLearnt Community page is a dedicated space where learners, instructors, and professionals come together to share knowledge, seek support, and collaborate on educational goals. This vibrant online community fosters interaction through forums, discussion groups, and collaborative projects, enhancing the learning experience by providing a platform for networking, peer support, and collective growth. Whether you're looking to ask questions, share insights, or connect with like-minded individuals, the YouLearnt Community offers a welcoming environment for continuous learning and professional development.





Through the "Contact" page, our users can reach out to us with any queries 24/7. We are here to assist with all your questions and inquiries.








How are courses conducted on the YouLearnt platform?

YouLearnt offers live, interactive courses where tutors and students meet in real-time via video conferencing. The platform provides multiple interactive tools to enhance the learning experience, ensuring an engaging and effective educational process. Unlike pre-recorded courses, all lessons are conducted live.



Does YouLearnt offer free courses?

Yes, YouLearnt occasionally offers free courses in various fields. To find them, check the Group Courses page regularly for available free courses in your area of interest.



Does YouLearnt work only for individuals (tutors and learners)?

No, YouLearnt also partners with educational institutions, schools, and universities. The platform provides a unique online learning environment to support institutions that wish to offer online or hybrid education. Schools and universities can use YouLearnt to deliver lessons to their students through their own teachers.

Institutions interested in collaborating with YouLearnt can contact YouLearnt here.

I’m a YouLearnt user, and I would like to raise a concern or contact the support team.

YouLearnt has a dedicated Support Hub for users. To access it:

Go to your Profile Settings.

Select Support Hub from the list.

Create a new ticket to start communicating with the platform.



As a YouLearnt tutor, how can I get students?



Students will be searching for and reaching out to you, so it’s essential to be prepared.

Make your profile attractive:

Use a professional profile picture.

Upload an engaging introduction video.

Fill out the rest of your profile details, including your certificates and qualifications.

Update your availability regularly:

Students cannot book lessons without available time slots.

You can schedule your availability up to a month in advance.

Respond to messages promptly:

The platform notifies you via email when you receive a message from a student.

Treat these messages seriously and reply as quickly as possible to show professionalism.

Encourage positive reviews:

After teaching your first student, ask them to leave a positive review.

Reviews build trust and help attract more students.





How does YouLearnt work for tutors, coaches, teachers, mentors, and educators?

Think of your personal account as your own online education center. You’ll have full control over the subjects you offer, set your own prices, choose your available teaching hours, and issue certificates for your students, all from your dashboard.



Getting started is simple:

Step 1: Create your account (this takes less than two minutes).

Step 2: Set your subject pricing (be sure to review the pricing policy first).

Step 3: Schedule your availability. Learners cannot reserve lessons without available time slots (you can always set your availability a month in advance).

Once you’ve completed these steps, you’re ready to start teaching! To attract more students, consider enhancing your profile.





How can I work as a tutor, coach, teacher, mentor, or an educator on YouLearnt?

You can start working on YouLearnt at any time without complications. Simply create an account, set up your profile, and showcase your skills to attract learners who can start booking lessons with you.



What does "Certificate Hours" mean on the Subjects page?

Certificate Hours refer to the number of hours set by the tutor as a requirement for issuing a certificate to the learner upon completion. The minimum requirement is 7 hours.



How does a learner top up their wallet to book with a tutor on YouLearnt?

Before reserving a One-to-One class or booking a group course, the wallet must be topped up with sufficient balance. Learners can do this through their home page by clicking on "Wallet Top-Up." Multiple payment options are available to make the process convenient.



How does a tutor withdraw their earnings on YouLearnt?

Tutors can withdraw their earnings on YouLearnt through several popular financial channels, including PayPal, Wise, or Payoneer. This can be done via the Finance page in the dashboard.



As a tutor on YouLearnt, am I obligated to set a specific number of daily teaching hours?

No, working hours are entirely up to you. You determine the number of hours you work with complete flexibility, based on your busy schedule, time zone, and personal vacations.

We allow tutors to schedule their availability up to a month in advance. When you visit the availability page, you can set your preferred teaching times for the next 30 days. Learners will then be able to book lessons during those times.

If your plans change and you are unavailable for a previously scheduled time, you can easily update your availability by removing the time slot from the availability page.

How does a tutor withdraw their earnings on YouLearnt?

Tutors can withdraw their earnings on YouLearnt through several popular financial channels, including PayPal, Wise, or Payoneer. This can be done via the Finance page in the dashboard.



As a tutor on YouLearnt, am I obligated to set a specific number of daily teaching hours?

No, working hours are entirely up to you. You determine the number of hours you work with complete flexibility, based on your busy schedule, time zone, and personal vacations.

We allow tutors to schedule their availability up to a month in advance. When you visit the availability page, you can set your preferred teaching times for the next 30 days. Learners will then be able to book lessons during those times.

If your plans change and you are unavailable for a previously scheduled time, you can easily update your availability by removing the time slot from the availability page.



I’m a learner, and I can’t find the subject I want to learn on YouLearnt. What can I do?

One of the challenges YouLearnt addresses is the difficulty of finding tutors for specialized subjects or rare skills. To solve this, we’ve enabled learners to add new subjects to the platform through the Tutor Request page. Once the platform approves the subject, it becomes live, allowing tutors to teach it and learners to study it on YouLearnt.

Similarly, tutors can suggest new subjects they wish to teach or skills they have mastered through the Subjects page in their control panel.



How do you find the right tutor, coach, educator, mentor, or teacher on YouLearnt?

There are two ways to find the right tutor on YouLearnt:

Using the Find Tutors page

Through this page, you can filter tutors based on several criteria, including:

The subject you want to learn.

The tutor’s native language and other languages they speak.

The tutor’s country of residence.

Hourly rates.

Availability for direct booking based on their teaching schedule.

Publishing a Tutor Request

Include information such as:

The required subject.

Your expected hourly rate.

The preferred language of instruction.

After publishing, tutors will respond with offers indicating their availability and interest. You can then review the responses and choose the tutor that best fits your needs to begin your learning journey.



What does the Introduction Video mean, and what should it be like?

The Introduction Video is the video that appears on your tutor profile. It needs approval from the platform, so it might not be visible immediately after you upload it.

The introduction video is your first opportunity to convince students that you’re the right tutor for them.

YouLearnt Introduction Video Tips:

Only you should appear in the video.

Avoid distractions, such as a cluttered background or noisy audio.

Look directly into the camera.

Do not read from a script; speak naturally.

Keep the video duration between two to five minutes.

Use a friendly and approachable tone.

Ensure the video is specifically created for YouLearnt.

Make sure to answer the following questions in your video:

What is your first name?

What subjects do you teach?

What certificates or experiences do you have?

What is your nationality?

What languages can you teach in?

What dialect do you speak?

End your video by encouraging learners to book a trial lesson with you.

You can either use a YouTube link or upload your video directly to YouLearnt using this link after logging in: Profile description - YouLearnt



How do tutors handle hourly rates, and are YouLearnt salaries fixed?

YouLearnt operates with a flexible pricing policy, allowing tutors to set their own hourly rates based on what they deem appropriate. This approach recognizes the diversity of specializations, experiences, and the country from which the tutor teaches.

As for the platform's commission, detailed information about the percentages and pricing structure is available on the Pricing Policy page, accessible via this link: YouLearnt Pricing Policy

Can tutors publish on the YouLearnt blog?

Yes, through their tutor accounts, they can request to publish an article in their field of specialization. Each submission is reviewed by the platform's team, and there are several conditions for approving the article before publication on the blog. To maintain high-quality content that effectively serves our readers, we ask contributors to follow the guidelines below:

Article Length

Word Count: Articles should be between 800–1,500 words to ensure depth while remaining digestible.

Content Focus

Articles should be informative, well-researched, and educational. Our audience includes students, educators, and lifelong learners, so content must provide valuable insights and practical advice.

Preferred topics include:

Learning techniques

Subject matter deep dives (e.g., Math, Science, History)

Educational technology

Career development

Tips for academic success

Online education

Prohibited Topics

Avoid subjects unrelated to education, such as:

Political opinions

Religious content (unless directly relevant to educational studies)

Offensive or divisive material

Promotions of products or services

Originality and Plagiarism

All submissions must be original and unpublished elsewhere. We do not tolerate plagiarism. Please cite any sources you reference with proper attribution.

Writing Style

Articles should be clear, engaging, and professional. Avoid overly complex jargon or technical terms unless they are essential to the subject.

Use subheadings to break up long sections and make content easier to follow.

Final Note

We aim to publish helpful and actionable content for a diverse readership. Ensure your writing is inclusive and avoids any language that may be perceived as discriminatory or offensive.



What does the profile score mean in YouLearnt?

The profile score on the YouLearnt platform is a percentage that reflects a tutor’s overall profile strength. It is determined by several factors, including completing the profile (such as adding an introductory section and listing certificates obtained), practical experience, availability for teaching on the platform, student reviews, and more. A higher profile score increases the tutor's visibility in search results on the Find Tutor page.



What ages does YouLearnt cover?

We believe that a certain age does not mark the end of learning. Therefore, YouLearnt is suitable for all ages without any restrictions.



Can children take lessons on YouLearnt?

Yes, they can. The parents can create an account on YouLearnt, choose a tutor, and manage lessons. All the child has to do is attend class on time.



How much do lessons cost?

There are differences in price between tutors. You will search for a tutor who teaches the subject in the language you want. You will find different prices as each tutor sets the hourly cost for lessons. You can choose a tutor with an hourly rate that suits you.



What are the subjects that YouLearnt covers?

At YouLearnt, we strive to provide comprehensive coverage of all subjects. In case you are unable to find the subject you require, as a student, you may create a post requesting a tutor who can teach it. If you are a tutor, and you cannot find the subject you desire to teach on our list of subjects, you may request to add it.



What is a trial session on YouLearnt?

A trial session is the initial meeting between a learner and a tutor. It is charged at the same rate as the tutor's regular hourly fee listed on their profile. During this session, the learner has the opportunity to get to know the tutor and decide if they are the right fit moving forward.



What does a package mean?

A package refers to the number of hours a learner reserves with a tutor after completing the trial session, allowing them to schedule future lessons with the same tutor.



Can a learner reserve more than one trial session?

Each learner is entitled to one trial session with each new tutor. After completing the session, the student should have a clear idea of whether the tutor is a good fit. If satisfied, they can reserve an unlimited number of packages with that tutor. If the learner wishes to try a different tutor, the process starts again: they reserve a trial session, followed by packages if they choose to continue.



Which countries are YouLearnt tutors from?

YouLearnt is a global platform where tutors from any country can register as tutors, aimed at removing geographical boundaries and making learning accessible to all.

YouLearnt operates 24/7, with tutors from various countries and time zones. This diversity allows learners to find available tutors at any time of the day. Additionally, you'll find tutors ready to teach on weekends and holidays.



How does learning work on YouLearnt?

YouLearnt primarily emphasises one-to-one sessions, as we believe this approach provides personalised instruction that effectively addresses each learner's unique needs. In addition, we also offer group courses, where learners and tutor participate simultaneously.
